situation: A family group chat: a dad, his adult daughter and his brother.
topic: Immigration has been all over the news this week and the dad has strong views on it.

text: Dad whats your take on all the immigration stuff on the news this week
Depends which bit. Its all shouting at the minute
Whole lot of it is about numbers and nobody can say what the numbers are
Ok fair. The hospital one tho? The staffing stuff
Im not asking for a debate im asking what you think
I think folk who work hard and pay their way should get a fair hearing. I think the system's a mess and that's been true for years whoever was in charge
Dont take that as me having it all worked out
Ha ok thats fair enough. Ill take it
Is the turkey still on for the 25th or are we doing the ham again
Ham pls. Ill do the sprouts
Ham's fine by me
Whos doing the spuds
Ill do the spuds. And the gravy if nobody else wants it
Gravy is a minefield tbh just do the spuds
Fine. I'll do the gravy too
Im on nights till wed so cant do the big shop til after
Ill do the shop Monday. Ham from the butchers on the Lisburn Rd
Anyone want anything else
Pudding. Not the cheap one
Dad is it the trifle or the christmas pud
Trifle. Desmond will want the pud regardless
Correct
Whos driving to yours on the day. I dont want to be the one drinking
Dont be daft you can stay over
Dad my room is still full of your boxes
Ill get a taxi back if it comes to that
Youll get a bed and like it
Fine
Butchers want the ham ordered by Wed. Ill ring them tmrw
Just woke up. Is anyone doing cloves or is that my job too
Check the press, there's a jar in there from 2019
2019 cloves ok
Long one today. House out in Dundonald, whole ground floor gone in the flood last month. Woman had her mum's stuff in boxes on the lawn
Cant do much for them only the number on the form
Oh uncle Des thats grim
You alright?
Yeah. Just didnt want to stand in a wet kitchen for hours and then go home to nothing
Did she have insurance
Some. Not enough. Thats not on me though
No it isnt
Want me to come round on the 6th? Bring the pud with me. Not the cheap one
Dont you dare buy it. Im bringing it
Stayed up for the film. Terrible
Cant sleep. Nights start tmrw so ill be up anyway
Still up?
